intro: Entries, tastings and scores: how a baking contest is told in Spanish.

apuntarse.nota: Always followed by a: me apunto a.

bloques.texto:
**Before.** The organisers **convocan un concurso**: **de repostería**, **de cocina** or **de pasteles**. Each contestant chooses **una receta**, buys the ingredients and trains. The neighbours **comentan** who will win. The day before is **el día de descanso**, when nobody is allowed to practise.

**The day.** Each **concursante** goes to **la cocina del concurso**, puts on **el delantal**, mixes the dough with **la batidora** and puts the cake in **el horno**. You can also **rendirte**, **repetir la receta** or **pedir más tiempo**. The number of people who come is **la asistencia**; the rest stay at home.

**After.** The tastings become **puntos**. A cake with the top score is **la ganadora**. If two cakes have the same score, they **empatan** and there is **un empate**. The others are **los finalistas**.

**The tasters.** In the village, **los catadores** sit at **la mesa grande** and **los pasteleros** wait in **la cocina**. Together they are **el concurso**.

**The three steps.** **La masa**, **el horno** and **la decoración**.

**Losing heart.** A contestant **se rinde**. A cake falls after **un mal horneado**. A day when everything goes wrong is **un desastre**, and what follows is **una segunda oportunidad**.

**Verbs with prepositions.** **Apuntarse a** un concurso, **presentarse a** una prueba, **pertenecer a** un club, **encargarse de** la nata.

frases.es: A las ocho de la tarde se apagaron los hornos y empezó una de las noches más largas que se recuerdan.
frases.en: At eight in the evening the ovens were switched off and one of the longest nights in memory began.
analisis: A las ocho de la tarde
una de las noches más largas

frases.es: La sala se había llenado al setenta por ciento, cinco puntos más de lo que anunciaban los organizadores.
frases.en: The hall had filled to seventy per cent, five points more than the organisers had announced.
analisis: de lo que anunciaban los organizadores

frases.es: Con la mitad de las tartas probadas, ninguna se acercaba a la máxima puntuación.
frases.en: With half the cakes tasted, none was getting close to the top score.
analisis: Con la mitad de las tartas probadas

frases.es: El pastelero del barrio había perdido diez puntos, pero seguía siendo el más aplaudido.
frases.en: The neighbourhood pastry chef had lost ten points, but was still the most applauded.

frases.es: Poco antes de medianoche, la catadora más veterana anunció que estaba dispuesta a premiar a cualquiera que respetara la receta original.
frases.en: Shortly before midnight, the most veteran taster announced that she was willing to reward anyone who respected the original recipe.

frases.es: Nadie se rindió esa noche, aunque más de un concursante se quedó sin nata.
frases.en: Nobody gave up that night, although more than one contestant ran out of cream.

frases.es: Los organizadores coinciden en que, a menos que se resuelva el empate, habrá que repetir la final antes del verano.
frases.en: The organisers agree that, unless the tie is settled, the final will have to be repeated before the summer.

bloques.pregunta: According to the text, did any cake get the top score?

opciones.No: Ninguna se acercaba a la máxima puntuación.
opciones.Yes, the last one: Only half the cakes had been tasted by then.

bloques.pregunta: According to the text, what will happen if the tie is not settled?

opciones.The pastry chef will give up: Giving up is a distractor; the question asks what happens if the tie stays.
opciones.The oldest taster will decide: Deciding is a distractor; the question asks about repeating the final instead.

bloques.pregunta: The appliance that bakes the cake is…
Complete: I always sign up for the same contest.

opciones.por el: The usual form is apuntarse a.

bloques.pregunta: Complete: unless the tie is settled…
bloques.frase: A menos que se ___ el empate…

opciones.resuelva: A menos que takes the subjunctive.
opciones.resuelve: A menos que takes the subjunctive.
opciones.resolverá: A menos que takes the subjunctive.

opciones.explicacion: Se ha rendido means has given up and stopped competing.
Rendirse is to give up of one's own will.

bloques.frase: La organización ha convocado la final para el mes de mayo
bloques.traduccion: The organisation has called the final for May.

bloques.texto:
**The app cannot check this part.** For the writing, please use pen and paper. For the speaking, say it out loud and, if you can, practise with a native speaker or a teacher who can correct you.

**Write (150–180 words).** Write a description of a contest you took part in or watched: preparation, surprises and result.

**Speak (about 3 minutes).** Explain aloud why many people enjoy competitions, and whether it is better to compete alone or in a team.
